// Item barcodes are 14 digits; the last is a Luhn check digit over the first 13.

/** Removes the spaces and dashes that scanners and people put in a barcode. */
export function normaliseBarcode(input) {
  return input.replace(/[\s-]/g, '');
}

/** Returns the Luhn check digit of a string of digits. */
export function checkDigit(digits) {
  let sum = 0;
  [...digits].reverse().forEach((character, index) => {
    const digit = Number(character);
    const weighted = index % 2 === 0 ? digit * 2 : digit;
    sum += weighted > 9 ? weighted - 9 : weighted;
  });
  return (10 - (sum % 10)) % 10;
}

/** Tells whether a normalised barcode has 14 digits and the right check digit. */
export function isValidBarcode(barcode) {
  if (!/^\d{14}$/.test(barcode)) return false;
  return checkDigit(barcode.slice(0, 13)) === Number(barcode[13]);
}

content.text:
The self-check machines now accept a card number with spaces or dashes in it, such as `2123 4000 5678 90` or `2123-4000-5678-90`. All 60 tests pass, including a new one for this.

- **Cause:** `findMemberByCard` compared the scanned card number to the stored one exactly. `2123 4000 5678 90` never matched `21234000567890`, so the machines replied `unknown-member`.
- **Fix:** In `lib/members/accounts.js` I added `normaliseCardNumber`, which strips spaces and dashes the way `normaliseBarcode` does for item barcodes. `findMemberByCard` now normalises its input before the lookup. I put it there, not in the SIP2 parser, so any other caller gets the same behaviour. At the moment only the self-check handler calls it.
- **Test:** `test/sip2.test.js` checks out an item with three card forms: spaced, dashed, and mixed with leading and trailing spaces. Each must be lent to the right member.

My first Bash call, which wrote both files in one command, was denied automatically because there was no one to approve it. Nothing from it was applied. I made the same edits with the Write and Edit tools instead, and `npm test` then ran normally.

`CLAUDE.md` still lists the self-check protocol under `lib/legacy/sip2.js`, but the latest commit moved it to `lib/selfcheck/sip2.js`. I left that alone because it's outside this request. Do you want me to update the map?
